courses.summary: The Bachelor of Game Development – Major in Game Art is a specialist degree that targets the development of artistic, creative, cognitive and technical skills required by game artists. You will gain a deep critical understanding of digital game art and production through: critical analysis of games and animations creation of levels, avatars and animations in highly advanced game projects. Developed in conjunction with Australia’s leading game studios, AIE Institute degree programs are continuously reviewed in close consultation with industry and delivered by industry-experienced faculty. The Bachelor of Game Development program mirrors the practices, workflows and standards of the game development industry, ensuring you will graduate work ready. From the first semester of the degree, you will work on group projects in a dynamic and multidisciplinary studio-simulated environment. You will also learn fundamental business knowledge and skills tailored to the requirements of the game industry, preparing you to launch your own game products and operate a sustainable game studio. You will graduate from the Bachelor of Game Development as a highly qualified and academically trained individual with skills in high demand by the games industry. Highly skilled in the utilisation of tools and the creation of innovative and immersive digital game content, you will be a critical thinker, technical entrepreneur and cultural ambassador for the game industry.
courses.careers: Digital 3D generalist, digital 3d modeler, digital animator, digital character artist, digital environment artist, digital lighting artist, digital rigger, digital sculptor, digital technical artist, game developer, game entrepreneur, graphical user interface artist, level designer, QA tester, technical tester, surfacing/texture artist, visual effects artist.
courses.practicalExperience: Extensive studio work throughout the degree plus an opportunity to participate in the work-integrated learning (WIL) internship program in the final semester. This program provides students with opportunities to use their technical, artistic and creative skills and knowledge in a game studio workplace, developing games, simulations, gamified applications and advanced technologies for human–computer interaction.

courses.summary: Level up your coding skills and learn how to build immersive games experiences and ingenious software tools with the Bachelor of Game Development – Major in Game Programming. In this specialist degree you will explore the intricacies of game development, learning programming languages like C++ and C# to breathe life into your digital creations. Under the mentorship of industry gurus, you'll fine-tune your programming know-how, diving headfirst into exciting subjects like artificial intelligence, computer graphics, physics simulation and AR/VR development. This degree gives you the opportunity to collaborate with passionate students in our game design and game art courses. Together you will be forging unique and innovative experiences to entertain and showcase your skills.
